verdict.rationale: Snyk documents an official local MCP server (Snyk Studio) that runs via the Snyk CLI and integrates with agentic dev environments, letting coding agents invoke Snyk scans via natural-language prompts or config, and this is corroborated by a probe confirming the doc page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's real-world reliability and broader third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
